## Checklist

- [ ] `npx expo-doctor` passes.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes (0 problems).
- [ ] Documentation updated (relevant `docs/` file + index) where behaviour/structure changed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or `.env` contents are included.
- [ ] No generated native folders (`ios/`, `android/`) were edited by hand.
